decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The glazing within the front wall of the property shall be oversized acoustic laminated double glazing system 12/17/12mm or as otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 2 - 2.	Timber framing shall be used on the windows on the front elevation as shown on the original drawing TP07A Approved, unless otherwise agreed with the Local Planning Authority.
description: Details of materials required by condition 2, details of sound insulation required by condition 10 and details of air quality required by condition 11 of planning permission 00657/57-59/P2 dated 25/06/2009 for the erection of second floor rear extensions and a new third floor/roof extension to 57, 58 and 59 and a first floor rear extension to 58 and 59 resulting in the enlargement of existing flats on first and second floor of 59 and creation of one additional flat at 59 at third floor/roof level and change of use to the upper floors of 57 and 58 to six self-contained flats, three in each building. Retention of ground floor and basement office use (A2) at 57 and 58 and use of basement and ground floor of 59 as restaurant use (A3).
